coordinateBase: chapter and paragraph both one-based; aligned in both editions

characters.name: Alice
characters.identityNotes: Do not register Mary Ann, Mabel or Ada as Alice aliases. Mary Ann is a mistaken address; Ada and Mabel are other children she speculates about.

characters.name: Alice’s sister
characters.identityNotes: Unnamed frame-story person. Resolve contextual mentions only; do not import a biographical name.

characters.name: The White Rabbit
characters.identityNotes: Rabbit and herald are contextual roles of this individual. Do not resolve every lowercase rabbit mention automatically.

characters.name: Dinah
characters.identityNotes: Alice’s cat at home; distinct from the Cheshire Cat. Referred to in dialogue, not physically present in Wonderland.

characters.name: The Mouse
characters.identityNotes: The pool companion. Distinct from Dormouse and from the mouse in its inset Fury poem.

characters.name: The Dodo
characters.identityNotes: Caucus-race organiser. Do not replace identity with a biographical Carroll identification.

characters.name: The Duck
characters.identityNotes: Separate pool companion.

characters.name: The Lory
characters.identityNotes: Separate pool companion; not the Eaglet.

characters.name: The Eaglet
characters.identityNotes: Separate pool companion.

characters.name: Pat
characters.identityNotes: Rabbit’s helper; preserve dialect. Species is not specified by the reading text.

characters.name: Bill the Lizard
characters.identityNotes: Bill is heard before the species identification at 4:34. Do not reveal Lizard in a position-gated first card before 4:34. Same juror in chapters 11–12.

characters.name: The Caterpillar
characters.identityNotes: First visible at the end of chapter 4; not first introduced in chapter 5.

characters.name: The Pigeon
characters.identityNotes: Nesting bird that mistakes Alice for a serpent. Serpent is an accusation, not a canonical Alice alias.

characters.name: The Fish-Footman
characters.identityNotes: Messenger distinct from the Frog-Footman; both appear in the same first paragraph.

characters.name: The Frog-Footman
characters.identityNotes: Door attendant; unqualified Footman is contextual after Fish-Footman leaves.

characters.name: The Duchess
characters.identityNotes: First mentioned by Rabbit in 2:8; first physically seen in 6:19. Keep a mention-only initial card until then.

characters.name: The Duchess’s cook
characters.identityNotes: Pepper-box witness is the same cook. First body appearance is 6:19; generic cook references must be context checked.

characters.name: The Duchess’s baby
characters.identityNotes: Baby/pig continuity is a delayed reveal. Add pig alias only after 6:48; do not expose transformation in pre-reading cast.

characters.name: The Cheshire Cat
characters.identityNotes: Initially an unnamed grinning cat; Cheshire name supplied at 6:23. Not Dinah.

characters.name: The Hatter
characters.identityNotes: First mentioned by Cat; first seen at 7:1. Mad Hatter is a familiar external label, not the source name; do not add as text alias.

characters.name: The March Hare
characters.identityNotes: First mentioned by Cat; seen at 7:1. Separate from White Rabbit.

characters.name: The Dormouse
characters.identityNotes: Distinct from pool Mouse; alternating pronouns do not create multiple entities.

characters.name: Two
characters.identityNotes: First unnamed speaker at 8:1; name revealed at 8:6. Gardener; name matching must be case/context aware.

characters.name: Five
characters.identityNotes: Rose-painting gardener. Do not match the number five outside gardener dialogue.

characters.name: Seven
characters.identityNotes: Rose-painting gardener. Do not match the number seven without context.

characters.name: The Queen of Hearts
characters.identityNotes: First mentioned in invitation; seen at 8:11. This is NOT the Red Queen from Through the Looking-Glass.

characters.name: The King of Hearts
characters.identityNotes: Specific monarch distinct from generic guest Kings. Judge alias applies from chapter 11 only.

characters.name: The Knave of Hearts
characters.identityNotes: Crown-bearer, later defendant. Prisoner alias applies at trial; accusation is not established guilt.

characters.name: The Gryphon
characters.identityNotes: Retain source spelling. Do not introduce a separate Griffin entity.

characters.name: The Mock Turtle
characters.identityNotes: First mentioned by Queen; seen at 9:48. Distinct from remembered schoolmaster Tortoise.

characters.name: Tortoise
characters.identityNotes: Remembered schoolmaster, an old Turtle. Tortoise/taught us pun is not a biological correction.

insetFigures.decision: Separate inset figures; never identify Father William with William the Conqueror.
Treat as inset story roles; do not automatically merge its mouse with the narrator Mouse.
Three distinct fictional sisters within an inset story; no biographical aliases.
Keep within poem contexts; generic sea creatures are not globally unique people.

insetFigures.scope: historical quotation and narrator comparison, chapters 2–3
insetFigures.decision: Optional reference entries only, not active Wonderland cast.

otherMinorFigures: Ada, Mabel, Mary Ann, Alice’s brother and nurse, Crab and daughter, Magpie, Canary and children, puppy, guinea-pigs, executioner, royal children and soldiers may receive position-gated supporting cards if needed. Do not invent proper names or merge species groups with individuals.
integration: Proposal is not a runtime character file. Derive mentions against the exact final edition hashes and validate spoiler timing. No mention offsets or generated production cards are supplied.
